headline: OEB: Oversimplifications and anathemas do not reduce the cost of electricity
summary: The Cyprus Consumers' Association stressed that easing high electricity costs requires a series of actions regardless of the causes behind the current situation. The statement criticised oversimplified proposals.
why: Electricity prices affect industrial costs, inflation and household budgets in Cyprus. Energy policy decisions shape the competitiveness of local businesses.
